what: Corrective rebuild of the grave-citation lemma repair after the citation-form gate moved upstream into Dilemma.

supersedes.note: That earlier corpus-side repair cleared the audit class by post-processing lemma tables against Dilemma c9aed53. This rebuild uses the normal corpus builders against committed Dilemma 0b93997, whose default policy blocks untrusted grave citation lemmas and whose strict_ag policy is available for citation audits.

cache_policy.remaining_missing_forms_policy: Dilemma guess=False found no structured answer, so the forms were recorded in data/cache/lemma_rejected.tsv for this rebuild rather than sent through the local transformer/model guess path.
cache_policy.why: The repair target is citation-form hygiene. No lemma is better than adding model-guessed headwords while proving the grave audit class is empty.
